text: IMF staff assesses that EFF program implementation has generally been good, with all end-June 2024 quantitative targets met and net international reserves accumulation 5.6 percent above the program target. Structural reforms are moving forward despite several delays. Under the RSF, some measures proved more complex than authorities and IMF staff originally thought, prompting proposed modifications for five of the remaining nine reform measures. Dropping negative climate tagging appears infeasible before the program ends, while overall reform ambition remains high.
